subject.title: refactor: delete dead infra and config exports

question: After resolving the current conflicts and reviewing the resulting exact-head diff, is the remaining test and contract coverage sufficient to land this broad dead-export cleanup?
rationale: The patch is intentionally broad and carries a protected maintainer signal; static review cannot safely decide whether the final conflict resolution preserves every internal lifecycle and test-contract boundary.

options.title: Resolve and verify exact head
options.body: Reconcile the branch with current `main`, inspect the failed large shard, and land only after the affected broad checks pass on the resulting head.

options.title: Narrow the cleanup
options.body: Split config, infra, and test-seam removal into smaller independently verified changes if conflict resolution leaves the combined branch too difficult to audit.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Close or supersede this branch if keeping it current requires repeated high-risk conflict repair that outweighs the dead-export reduction.

recommendation.title: Resolve and verify exact head
recommendation.body: Reconcile the branch with current `main`, inspect the failed large shard, and land only after the affected broad checks pass on the resulting head.

likelyOwner.reason: Owns both the merged dead-export ratchet and the branch's recent invariant-preservation work, making them the strongest available decision-routing candidate.
